multiple_testing.continuous_linear_family: one continuous univariable Cox test per completed single-gene benchmark scenario
multiple_testing.continuous_nonlinearity_family: one spline-versus-linear likelihood-ratio test per completed single-gene benchmark scenario
multiple_testing.grouped_family: four prespecified two-group cutpoint sensitivities within this marker-endpoint scenario
multiple_testing.maxstat_input: Lau94 selection-adjusted rank-statistic p-value; naive post-selection log-rank p is descriptive only

endpoint_policy.default_rule: OS is the primary endpoint for cross-scenario comparability when it satisfies TCGA-CDR operational QC.
endpoint_policy.prespecified_exception: TCGA-UVM BAP1 uses DSS as its primary endpoint because the literature anchor concerns disease-specific metastatic prognosis in uveal melanoma. Current DSS analysis treats other-cause death as non-informative censoring.
endpoint_policy.sensitivity_rule: Additional endpoints are labelled endpoint sensitivities and cannot replace the registered primary endpoint because of a more favorable effect or p-value.
endpoint_policy.unavailable_endpoint_rule: A registered endpoint that fails operational QC remains a visible non-evaluable scenario; no outcome-driven endpoint substitution is allowed.

scenario.endpoint_rationale: OS is the registered default primary endpoint and is available in both TCGA-TRACE and the external comparison.
scenario.inclusion_rationale: Preserves a canonical clear-cell renal carcinoma marker for nonlinear continuous modelling and comparison with an external survival resource.

literature_anchors.scope: CA9 biology and debated prognostic value in clear-cell renal carcinoma; RNA abundance is not equivalent to immunohistochemical CA9.

selection_history.future_change_rule: A scenario may be added, removed or reclassified only in a new registry version with a written rationale. Observed effect direction, effect magnitude or p-value from a regeneration cannot trigger an in-place change.
selection_history.statement: The marker panel was assembled after exploratory TCGA-TRACE triage. This registry does not claim prospective initial marker selection. It freezes the existing heterogeneous software stress-test panel before subsequent publication regeneration and revision.
